data.thought: We need to create the missing R epilogue that exports the standard bundle before we can run the export.

args.instructions: Write an R epilogue that loads the legacy model (cr001_scorecard.R), executes it on the sandbox data, and saves the resulting standard bundle (including the data frame, scores, decisions, and model coefficients) to a file named export_bundle.rds. Ensure the script exits cleanly so run_export can succeed.
